idea-plugin.name: IDEA ChatGPT Dictate — Feasibility Probe
idea-plugin.description: Diagnostic proof of concept for project-aware OpenAI dictation into an IDE AI chat composer. Reports editor context, discovers recent local Codex sessions, and tests focused-field insertion. Does not record audio, send data to a server, or send chat messages.

action.description: Show editor PSI context and recent local Codex session candidates
Paste a harmless marker at the currently focused text cursor (never sends a message)
